items.rationale: IF stops at the first TRUE test. If B2<C2 came first, 0 would match it and show Low. Testing the special case 0 first keeps Out of stock reachable.
10 and 40 are both inside the range because >= and <= include the limits. 0 and 5 are below the minimum and 45 is above the maximum. So 2 lines are OK.
50>=10 is TRUE and 50<=50 is TRUE, so AND returns TRUE. AND returns TRUE or FALSE, not a label, so the word OK would need an IF around it.
8 is not 0, so the first test fails. 8 is below the minimum of 10, so AND is FALSE. The next test 8<10 is TRUE, so the label is Low.
